name: Seated chest press machine
cues: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest
Keep your back against the pad
Press out without locking your elbows hard
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch

name: Incline chest press machine
cues: Adjust the seat so the handles start at upper chest height
Keep your shoulder blades back against the pad
Press up and forward
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows

name: Pec deck fly
cues: Set the seat so your arms are level with your chest
Keep a slight bend in your elbows
Bring the handles together in front of you
Open slowly until you feel a stretch

name: Seated dip machine
cues: Set the seat so the handles are at your sides
Keep your shoulders down
Press the handles down until your arms are straight
Do not shrug as you press

name: Machine shoulder press
cues: Set the seat so the handles start near shoulder height
Keep your back against the pad
Press up without shrugging
Lower slowly to the start

name: Machine lateral raise
cues: Set the seat so the pads sit just above your elbows
Lead with your elbows, not your hands
Raise to shoulder height
Do not shrug as you raise

name: Reverse pec deck
cues: Sit facing the pad with your chest supported
Hold the handles with a soft bend in your elbows
Open your arms out to the sides
Return slowly without letting the weights touch down

name: Chest-supported row machine
cues: Set the chest pad so you can reach the handles with straight arms
Pull your elbows back past your torso
Squeeze your shoulder blades together
Return slowly until your arms are straight

name: Assisted pull-up machine
cues: Choose a counterweight that lets you control the rep
Kneel or stand on the platform
Pull your chest toward the bar
Lower until your arms are straight

name: Machine pullover
cues: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine axis
Rest your elbows on the pads
Pull the bar down toward your hips
Return slowly to a full stretch

name: Hack squat machine
cues: Place your back flat on the pad and feet shoulder width
Lower until your thighs are near parallel
Keep your heels down
Push the sled away without locking out hard

name: Smith machine squat
cues: Place your feet slightly in front of the bar
Brace and sit down between your hips
Keep your heels flat
Stand up along the bar path

name: Smith machine bench press
cues: Line the bar up with your mid chest
Shoulder blades pinched and down
Lower the bar to your chest
Press up and rack it when finished

name: Smith machine incline press
cues: Set the bench to a low to medium incline
Line the bar up with your upper chest
Lower with control
Press up and rack the bar when finished

name: Smith machine shoulder press
cues: Set the bench upright under the bar
Lower the bar to about chin height
Press straight up
Rack the bar when finished

name: Pendulum squat
cues: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad
Lower until your thighs are below parallel if comfortable
Keep your heels down
Press up smoothly

name: Belt squat
cues: Attach the belt around your hips
Stand tall and brace
Sit down between your feet
Stand by pushing the floor away

name: Seated leg curl
cues: Adjust the pad so it sits just above your heels
Lock your thighs under the pad
Curl your heels under you
Keep your hips pressed into the seat

name: Hip abduction machine
cues: Sit upright with the pads on the outside of your knees
Push your knees apart
Pause at the widest point
Keep your back against the pad

name: Seated calf raise machine
cues: Set the pad on your lower thighs
Lower your heels to a full stretch
Rise onto the balls of your feet
Pause at the top

name: Leg press calf raise
cues: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform edge
Keep your knees nearly straight
Push the platform away with your toes
Lower to a full stretch without letting the weights slam

name: Glute kickback machine
cues: Brace your chest against the pad
Place your foot on the plate
Push back and up with your glute
Return slowly without swinging

name: Hip thrust machine
cues: Set the pad across your hips and fasten the belt
Place your feet flat and shoulder width
Drive your hips up and squeeze
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch

name: Back extension
cues: Set the pad just below your hip bones
Keep your back neutral
Hinge down then lift until your body is in a straight line
Do not hyperextend at the top

name: Reverse hyperextension
cues: Lie face down with your hips at the pad edge
Hold the handles and keep your torso still
Raise your legs to hip height without swinging
Keep your abs braced so your lower back stays still

name: Glute-ham raise
cues: Lock your feet in and set your knees just behind the pad
Lower your torso with your body in one line
Curl up using your hamstrings
Keep your hips extended throughout

name: Ab crunch machine
cues: Set the seat so the pads sit at your upper chest
Curl your trunk down and in
Exhale at the bottom
Return slowly without letting the weights drop

name: Torso rotation machine
cues: Sit upright and fix your hips
Rotate your torso from your trunk, not your arms
Pause at the end of the turn
Return slowly and do both sides

name: Machine biceps curl
cues: Set the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad
Curl up without lifting your elbows
Squeeze at the top
Lower to nearly straight arms

name: Machine triceps extension
cues: Set the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad
Keep your elbows pointing forward
Extend your arms fully
Return slowly to a deep bend

name: Machine shrug
cues: Stand or sit tall with your arms straight
Lift your shoulders straight up
Pause at the top
Lower without leaning forward
